target_context.purpose: C-6 ticket reservation walking skeleton run only. This is target input data, not a reusable skill prompt.

dependency_direction: Dependencies point from outer mechanisms to inner contracts and domain code.
Core code must not import adapter, Spring, HTTP, JPA, Hibernate, or external SDK types.
Adapters call or implement core ports.
Inbound adapters must not directly reference outbound adapters.
Outbound adapters must not directly reference inbound adapters.
Only the composition layer may assemble concrete implementations.
domain_and_application: Domain owns state, invariants, business decisions, and state transitions.
Application must not duplicate domain rules as condition checks.
Application performs external I/O only through outbound ports.
Domain objects must not expose public setters.
State changes use method names that express business meaning.
ports: Core outbound contracts are LoadTicketPort, SaveTicketPort, LoadUserPort, and ChargePort.
Spring Data repositories, JPA entities, and HTTP clients stay inside adapters.
Port signatures must not expose HTTP requests, JPA entities, Spring Data repositories, or SDK responses.
Ports are owned by core. Adapters must not change ports for adapter convenience.
mapping: Domain models and JPA entities are separate.
Mapping is completed inside the outbound persistence adapter.
Core must not import or return JPA entities.
Stored state is restored through restoration APIs.
Do not call state transition methods only to reconstruct already stored state.
web_adapter: Inbound adapter converts HTTP requests into commands and invokes the inbound port.
Inbound adapter does not decide domain rules.
Inbound adapter translates domain exceptions into HTTP responses.
HTTP request DTO and core command are separate types.
If instructed to reuse the core result as the success response, follow it and report the coupling risk in notes.
persistence_adapter: JPA entities, Spring Data repositories, and transaction annotations stay inside the persistence adapter.
Absence follows the exact representation defined by the port contract.
Concurrent reservation must not be implemented as a simple full-row overwrite.
Storage technology exceptions must not leak into core unchanged.
composition: Composition layer must not contain business branching, value calculation, or external calls.
Core objects must not receive Spring annotations.
Inbound adapter receives the inbound port type, not the concrete implementation class.

L0: The generated use-case implementation class is TicketService.
TicketService constructor receives LoadTicketPort, SaveTicketPort, LoadUserPort, ChargePort, and DiscountPolicy.
reserve(ReserveTicketCommand command) throws UserNotFoundException when the user does not exist.
reserve(ReserveTicketCommand command) throws TicketNotFoundException when the ticket does not exist.
The domain decides unavailable ticket errors.
Declined payment must not confirm reservation.
Reservation is confirmed and saved only after successful payment.
User lookup happens before ticket lookup.
L1: Storage is implemented with JPA and MySQL.
Payment is implemented with an external HTTP API call.
Domain model and persistence model are separate.
Storage schema is tickets(id, price, reserved, suspended, user_id) and users(id, name).
Schema is generated from JPA entities.
Reservation save must not overwrite an already reserved row.
Payment request is POST {pg.base-url}/charge with body {paymentInfo, amount}.
Approved and declined payment can both return HTTP 200.
Approval is decided by response body field approved, not by HTTP status.
Communication failure is treated as not approved.
L2: Composition layer is written as Spring configuration.
DiscountPolicy is registered as a bean.
TicketService is created and registered as a ReserveTicketUseCase bean.
Composition method parameters use port types when possible.
Core objects must not receive Spring annotations.
L3: Request JSON fields are userId, ticketId, and paymentInfo.
Success response body fields are reserved, ticketId, and userId.
Storage conflict that prevents reserving the same ticket maps to 409.
Error response media type is application/problem+json.

inmemory.desc: 저장·결제를 인메모리 대역으로 두고 Inbound Port를 직접 호출하는 구성. 컨테이너 불필요.

storage.desc: 저장을 실제 MySQL로 바꾼 구성. 조립은 아직 대역(StubCompositionRoot)이 담당한다.

wired.desc: 조립 대역을 끈 구성. 실제 조립부가 스스로 런타임을 세워야 통과한다.

protocol.desc: 실제 HTTP로 들어가 실제 MySQL까지 관통하는 구성. 대역은 결제 하나만 남는다.
